summary: BTC slipped under $80k overnight (~$79.8k, -1.3% 24h) after the Fed's hawkish hold (10-2, two hike dissents); markets now price ~78-80% odds of a December hike and ~$356M of mostly long liquidations hit. Offsets: BlackRock IBIT kept buying (ETF inflows $286M on 26-27 Oct) and Sen. Hagerty talked up expanding the US BTC reserve (conditional on stalled legislation). Retail interest at a 5-year low.
catalyst_note: Hawkish FOMC 28 Oct, Dec hike odds ~80%; $356M liquidations 29 Oct
